idea: The player lives through the attack in the messages, calls and updates a real employee would see.

channels.setting: The player's inbox, late in the working day
The incident chat after the night alert
A phone call to the night-shift work-order desk
The incident update as the day shift arrives

questions: Use the question bank for the decisions the player faces in each channel. Show the explanation and a visible consequence.
rules: Build incident updates, decisions, status changes and a debrief.
Keep the control score and the question results visible separately.
Use real text and real buttons for anything the player must read or press. Give pictures a text alternative.
